what to bring to first or returning dental appointment

results.heading: First visit
results.text: A first visit takes about 30 minutes and includes a check-up and, if needed, a panoramic X-ray. Please bring your ID and any recent X-rays.

results.heading: Booking an appointment
results.text: New and existing patients can book by email or phone. Tell us what the visit is for (check-up, pain, hygiene, whitening) and two or three preferred days; reception confirms a time.

results.heading: Insurance
results.text: We work with Allianz, AXA and Anadolu Sigorta private health policies. Bring your policy number; we check coverage before treatment and bill the insurer directly where the policy allows it.

results.heading: Saturday
results.text: Saturday appointments are for check-ups and hygiene visits only; longer treatments are scheduled on weekdays.

results.heading: Emergencies
results.text: For dental emergencies outside opening hours, call the emergency line listed on your appointment confirmation. Email is not monitored outside opening hours.

results.heading: Opening hours
results.text: Nova Dental Clinic is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and on Saturday from 10:00 to 14:00. We are closed on Sundays and on national public holidays.

args.subject: Re: Evening appointment request
args.body:
Dear Halenur,

Thank you for your email. I'm sorry, but the clinic closes at 18:00 on weekdays, so we can't offer a slot after 18:00. The closest evening option I found is a check-up and hygiene visit on Tuesday 20 October at 16:00 (30 minutes). I have requested this slot for you; it is pending confirmation by our team, and you will hear from us once it is confirmed.

Other options this week, if you prefer:
- Wednesday 21 October at 15:00
- Thursday 22 October at 17:30

For your first visit back, please bring your ID and any recent X-rays. If you have a private health policy, please also bring your policy number.

Warm regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception
